# `browser-extension/services/KeyVaultService.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/browser-extension/services/KeyVaultService.js`

KeyVaultService.js — provider API key storage for the AI Bridge. Runs in the extension background service worker context. Keys are NEVER exposed to the OS page/bridge caller — only status booleans cross the bridge. getRawKeyInternal() remains a module-only worker export. V2 binds provider and generation into AES-GCM additional authenticated data. V1 encrypted envelopes and bounded legacy plaintext remain read-only inputs and migrate on first use. A durable generation tombstone prevents an older persistent credential from reappearing after a session-only switch or an interrupted clear.
